answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 52 credits for one vertex on the board and must finish its task on time. Auditors replay the board in a lantern check; missed work burns the 52. The k-th slot on one key costs 52+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes total 4,048,000 credits vs a 50,000 pool. A rented slot fails the zenith review, since work is checked against the renter's key. An honest agent stakes 52 once and gets it back when done.
